expectations.text: 친구 요청 보내기(POST) 기능이 구현되어 있다
expectations.evidence: POST /api/friends handler in api_friends_route.ts (lines 114-208) creates a friendship record with status 'pending' after validating addressee_id, checking target user exists, and preventing self-requests.

expectations.text: 친구 요청 수락/거절(PATCH) 기능이 구현되어 있다 (status를 accepted/rejected로 변경)
expectations.evidence: PATCH /api/friends/[id] handler exists in api_friends_[id]_route.ts (lines 9-86) and supports 'accepted' status, but uses 'blocked' instead of 'rejected' (line 36: status must be 'accepted' or 'blocked'). The assertion specifically requires 'rejected' status support.
DELETE /api/friends/[id] handler in api_friends_[id]_route.ts (lines 88-134) deletes the friendship record after verifying the requesting user is part of the friendship.

expectations.text: 친구 목록 조회(GET)가 양방향으로 동작한다 (requester/addressee 모두 검색)
expectations.evidence: GET handler queries friendships where user is requester_id (line 68) and where user is addressee_id (line 90), then merges both into a unified 'friends' array (lines 98-109).

expectations.text: 중복 친구 요청을 방지하는 로직이 있다
expectations.evidence: POST handler checks for existing relationships in both directions using .or() query (lines 158-190), returning 409 for already-friends or pending requests. DB also has UNIQUE constraint on (requester_id, addressee_id).

expectations.text: 생성된 모든 파일에서 'any' 타입을 사용하지 않았다
expectations.evidence: Grep search for 'any' across all 4 output files returned no matches. All types are properly defined using specific types (string, FriendshipStatus, unknown, etc.).
